title: Event-Grounded Sparse Autoencoders for Vision-Language-Action Policies
abstract: arXiv:2605.17204v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies translate language and visual inputs into robot actions, where their hidden representations directly shape closed-loop behavior. However, mechanistic interpretability tools from language and vision-language models do not transfer cleanly to VLAs: outputs are robot actions rather than human-readable tokens, and validating internal changes requires expensive closed-loop rollouts. We propose an event-grounded interpretability pipeline that anchors SAE feature analysis to behavioral events rather than text contexts. We extract keyframes from end-effector trajectories and cluster them within each task using visual, robot-state, and temporal cues. The resulting events guide SAE feature ranking, with optional VLM annotations providing descriptions of the events. translated_title: 面向视觉-语言-动作策略的事件锚定稀疏自编码器
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略将语言和视觉输入转化为机器人动作，其隐藏表征直接塑造了闭环行为。然而，来自语言模型和视觉-语言模型的机制可解释性工具并不能顺利迁移到VLA：其输出是机器人动作而非人类可读的词元，且验证内部变化需要进行代价高昂的闭环回放。我们提出了一种以事件为锚点的可解释性流水线，将SAE特征分析锚定于行为事件而非文本语境。我们从末端执行器轨迹中提取关键帧，并利用视觉、机器人状态和时间线索在每个任务内对其进行聚类。由此得到的事件用于指导SAE特征排序，并可通过可选的VLM标注为事件提供描述。据我们所知，该流水线是首批将基于SAE的VLA分析建立在闭环行为事件之上的工作之一。在两个仿真……
tldr: 该论文提出一种以闭环行为事件为锚点的SAE可解释性流水线，通过从末端执行器轨迹提取关键帧并聚类来分析VLA策略的内部表征，是首批将基于SAE的VLA分析建立在机器人闭环行为事件之上的工作之一。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an event-grounded interpretability pipeline that anchors SAE feature analysis to closed-loop behavioral events via keyframe extraction and clustering from end-effector trajectories, making it among the first to ground SAE-based VLA analysis in robot behavior rather than text contexts.
